source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: It turns out I omitted one JST GH connector. This should be the final update, and I hope the board is still in the design phase.

routing_warnings.description: The requested additional I2C JST connector is specifically for the display light sensor and is better routed to the narrower light-sensor-port Requirement.
The revised specification specifically incorporates the light-sensor I2C connector rather than changing the general peripheral-connector set.
The instruction to use through-hole connectors throughout changes connector assembly technology, not connector-set completeness.
